name: Compute Comparison
tagline: Live GPU and LLM prices, specs and provider reviews
description:
Compare live and historical GPU cloud and LLM API prices, explore specs and provider reviews, and use cost tools and price alerts to choose your compute. Rate and review the providers you use.

Watch out: the homepage opened on 2026-11-14 compares GPU cloud listings and LLM API prices. It is a price comparison, not a model you prompt. Flagged as infrastructure pricing rather than a generative product. On 2026-11-14 the homepage title was "Compare 120+ GPU Cloud Providers and 70 LLM Providers," and the visible counters read 127 GPU providers with 701 listings and 70 LLM providers with 656 models. Example hourly GPU rows on that page included an RTX 3080 on OpenRelay at $0.18/hr and an RTX 3090 on Vast.ai at $0.22/hr.
